faqs.q: What is DWS IQ 6?
faqs.a: DWS IQ 6 is Nordic industrial AI, built in Finland by Lifetime Oy, that automates EU compliance for regulated industries — CSRD, CBAM, EU ETS, Fit for 55, EPBD and the EU AI Act.

faqs.q: Which industries does DWS IQ cover?
faqs.a: DWS IQ provides 16 captain hats covering 25 EU-regulated industries, including construction, energy, manufacturing, logistics, real estate, mining, financial services and the public sector.

faqs.q: Which EU regulations does DWS IQ help with?
faqs.a: DWS IQ supports EU climate and compliance regulations including CSRD sustainability reporting, CBAM carbon border adjustment, the EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS), Fit for 55, the EPBD for buildings, and the EU AI Act.

faqs.q: Is my data kept in the EU and is DWS IQ sovereign?
faqs.a: Yes. DWS IQ is EU sovereign AI under Finnish jurisdiction, designed to align with GDPR, NIS2 and the EU AI Act. Your data stays in the EU.
